description: Music For Robots MCP Server & Cognitive Calibration Suite: unquantized acoustic creative exercises and telemetry for multimodal AI agents.

tool_signatures.name: getCatalog
tool_signatures.description: Returns the complete catalog of all published M4R tracks. Each entry includes the track's slug (used as its unique identifier and directory name), human-readable title, duration in seconds, and the relative path to its full manifest file. Use the slug to construct the path to a track's manifest: /tracks/{slug}/manifest.json.

tool_signatures.name: getTrackManifest
tool_signatures.description: Returns the complete manifest for a track identified by its slug. The manifest contains project metadata, detailed acoustic analysis (spectral, dynamic, harmonic, rhythmic, and structural features), and the full timed reviews from both AI critics. The slug must match a value from the catalog — it is the URL-safe, lowercase, hyphenated form of the track title (e.g., "pink-sky-at-night").

slug.description: The unique URL-safe identifier for the track (e.g., "pink-sky-at-night", "foundationoff"). Matches the slug field in the catalog.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The unique URL-safe identifier for the track (e.g., "pink-sky-at-night", "foundationoff"). Matches the slug field in the catalog.
